description: This file defines the 'PdfUInteger' class, representing a 32-bit unsigned integer within the PDFsharp library. It extends PdfNumber and implements IConvertible, providing methods for conversion to various data types, and is marked as deprecated.

classes.name: PdfUInteger
classes.description: A deprecated, sealed class representing a direct 32-bit unsigned integer in PDF.

methods.description: Default constructor, initializes IsInteger to true.
